page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-16-lssd is a general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 16 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 60.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.75 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes 539 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across two local drives, offering high-speed local data access without a dedicated GPU.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-threaded performance. The instance achieves top-tier status in single-threaded gzip compression (36.82 GB/sec), single-threaded bzip3 decompression (15.64 GB/sec), and Geekbench single-core testing (2297.0). Text processing and small-model LLM text generation also rank in the top 10%. Multi-core and memory-bound operations, such as stress-ng multi-core CPU performance (18700.11) and large-block memory write bandwidth (56.89 GB/sec), fall within the average tier.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4-standard-16-lssd balances dedicated compute resources with high-speed local NVMe storage, making it a viable option for workloads requiring low-latency disk I/O without the premium cost of memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated instances. The hardware configuration is well-suited for database operations, web serving, software compilation, and lightweight text or language processing tasks.
